examples.explanation: One best path goes right, right, down, down. Starting with 7 keeps health above zero throughout.
No damage occurs, so 1 health suffices.
Entering a cell with -3 from 4 health leaves 1.

hints: Work backwards from the goal: each cell needs enough health to survive itself plus the cheaper of the right and down neighbours.
A cell needing x health means max(1, need(next) - dungeon[i][j]).
title: 324. Dungeon Game
